svg.aria-label: An upright X-Y chart recorder and a balance on one bench plate. The recorder's pen rides a gantry across chart paper that carries the caffeine 13C spectrum in CDCl3, eight peaks from 155.4 to 27.9 ppm, and climbs each peak in turn. Beside it a balance holds a cut of the measured chart on one pan and a candidate structure card on the other, with a rack of candidate cards behind it.
svg.text: MEASURED SHIFTS IN, RANKED STRUCTURES OUT
